resources.string: Coordinates use the working image shown above, before crop and resize. Edits apply in list order. Press Add edit to include the draft, then Generate output to review the result. Unadded draft fields are not applied. Edits are temporary and are cleared when choosing or removing an image, leaving this tool, or recreating this screen.

Blur and pixelation are not secure redaction. Prefer an opaque solid cover to obscure content, then inspect the final exported image carefully. No method here guarantees privacy; the original image remains unchanged.
Check coordinates, color and effect size. Regions must be nonempty and within the working image; arrows need distinct endpoints. The list is limited to 20 edits.

For regions, right and bottom are exclusive edges. For arrows, all four values are pixel coordinates: start X/Y to end X/Y in any direction, within 0 to image width/height minus 1. Endpoints must differ. Outline/arrow thickness: 1–32 pixels; blur radius: 1–32; pixelation block: 2–128. Color is opaque; alpha is unsupported.
Color: %1$s (outline, arrow or cover only) · Size: %2$d px (ignored for cover)
